text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim that driverless cars \"will be a great advancement\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position directly and sets up a consistent argument from the start."},{"evidence":"multiple reasons in body paragraphs: safety, disability access, productivity, transportation efficiency","quality":"development","description":"The essay supports its claim with several distinct points rather than relying on a single idea."},{"evidence":"references to car accidents, drunk driving, disabilities, and commuting time","quality":"use of support","description":"The essay draws on concrete consequences and article-based ideas to back up its argument."},{"evidence":"body organized into \"To begin,\" \"Another positive aspect,\" \"Third,\" and \"Lastly\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents its ideas in a clear sequence that is easier to follow."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates benefits and overall position","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by summarizing the argument and reinforcing the main claim."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"Transportation will be transformed completely\" and \"positively in many different ways\"","quality":"persuasive emphasis","description":"The writing uses stronger, more forceful language to make the argument sound confident and convincing."}]}
